constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (receipt_id) REFERENCES _migration.task69_receipt(receipt_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES admin_tasks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: task69_admin_origin_complete
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER task69_admin_origin_complete AFTER INSERT ON _migration.task69_admin_origin DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION _migration.task69_admin_receipt_complete()

triggers.name: task69_immutable

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX task69_admin_origin_pkey ON _migration.task69_admin_origin USING btree (task_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX task69_admin_origin_receipt_id_key ON _migration.task69_admin_origin USING btree (receipt_id)
